1	# Multi-Tenancy Harness
2	
3	How to run multiple isolated LunarWing instances on the same host using the test harness.
4	
5	For a single instance, see [`HARNESS-SINGLE-TENANT.md`](HARNESS-SINGLE-TENANT.md).
6	
7	## Port Map
8	
9	Every port used by the harness is now configurable via `LUNARWING_TEST_*` env vars.
10	Set them before running `init` to generate env files with your chosen ports.
11	
12	| Service | Variable | Default | Description |
13	|---------|----------|---------|-------------|
14	| PostgreSQL | `LUNARWING_TEST_PG_PORT` | 5432 | Postgres container host port |
15	| TensorZero proxy | `LUNARWING_TEST_PROXY_PORT` | 3002 | Local LLM routing proxy |
16	| TensorZero proxy bind | `LUNARWING_TEST_PROXY_BIND` | 127.0.0.1 | Proxy listen address |
17	| Gateway (REST API) | `LUNARWING_TEST_GATEWAY_PORT` | 8765 | LunarWing gateway HTTP |
18	| HTTP webhook | `LUNARWING_TEST_HTTP_PORT` | 9098 | Inbound webhook listener |
19	| XMPP bridge | `LUNARWING_TEST_BRIDGE_BIND` | 127.0.0.1:8787 | Bridge HTTP bind (host:port) |
20	| Weechat relay | `LUNARWING_TEST_WEECHAT_PORT` | 9001 | Weechat relay port (future) |
21	
22	## Example: Two Instances Side-by-Side
23	
24	### Instance A (defaults)
25	
26	```bash
27	cd ic
28	scripts/lunarwing-xmpp-test-env.sh init
29	scripts/lunarwing-xmpp-test-env.sh up
30	```
31	
32	### Instance B (all ports shifted)
33	
34	```bash
35	cd ic
36	export LUNARWING_TEST_ROOT=/tmp/lunarwing-tenant-b
37	export LUNARWING_TEST_PG_PORT=5433
38	export LUNARWING_TEST_PG_CONTAINER=lunarwing-test-postgres-b
39	export LUNARWING_TEST_PROXY_PORT=3003
40	export LUNARWING_TEST_GATEWAY_PORT=8766
41	export LUNARWING_TEST_HTTP_PORT=9099
42	export LUNARWING_TEST_BRIDGE_BIND=127.0.0.1:8788
43	export LUNARWING_TEST_WEECHAT_PORT=9002
44	
45	scripts/lunarwing-xmpp-test-env.sh init
46	scripts/lunarwing-xmpp-test-env.sh up
47	```
48	
49	Both stacks run independently with no port conflicts.
50	
51	## Secret Management Instructions:
52	
53	# For tenant A:                                                                                                       
54	  source /tmp/lunarwing-mt-a/env/lunarwing.env                                                                          
55	  python3 ic_sm/scripts_4_db/insert_secret_pg.py ...                                                                  
56	                                                            
57	  # For tenant B:                                           
58	  source /tmp/lunarwing-mt-b/env/lunarwing.env                                                                          
59	  python3 ic_sm/scripts_4_db/insert_secret_pg.py ...
60	
61	### Each tenant will have own master key and its own database on its own port so source the env vars is the way to go here.
62	
63	## Notes
64	
65	- Each instance needs its own `LUNARWING_TEST_ROOT` for isolated state/env/logs/pids.
66	- Each instance needs its own `LUNARWING_TEST_PG_CONTAINER` name to avoid Docker container conflicts.
67	- The `DATABASE_URL` is auto-derived from `PG_PORT` unless you override `LUNARWING_TEST_DATABASE_URL` explicitly.
68	- For libSQL instances, port conflicts are only on the service ports (no database container).
69	- Systemd unit names are also configurable via `LUNARWING_TEST_SERVICE_NAME`, `LUNARWING_TEST_BRIDGE_SERVICE_NAME`, and `LUNARWING_TEST_PROXY_SERVICE_NAME`.
70	
71	## Platform Support
72	
73	The harness is cross-platform. Init system detection is automatic:
74	
75	| Platform | `mt-up`/`mt-down` method | Service unit format |
76	|----------|--------------------------|---------------------|
77	| macOS | launchd user agents | `.plist` in `$TEST_ROOT/launchd/` → `~/Library/LaunchAgents/` |
78	| Linux (systemd) | systemd user units | `.service` in `$TEST_ROOT/systemd/` → `~/.config/systemd/user/` |
79	| Linux (OpenRC) | rc-service (direct) | direct process management fallback |
80	| Other | direct PID management | — |
81	
82	> **Note — OpenRC not yet been FULLY validated:** The OpenRC path has been implemented but has not been tested end-to-end on a real OpenRC system. (However, this task WILL be completed very soon...) `_mt_detect_init()` correctly identifies OpenRC and `doctor` reports `rc-service` status, but neither `mt-up`/`mt-down` nor single-tenant `up`/`down` have been run on Gentoo, Alpine, or any other OpenRC host. Treat the OpenRC path as best-effort until a full test is completed.
83	
84	### macOS Prerequisites
85	
86	Before running `mt-up` on macOS, ensure the WASM toolchain is set up:
87	
88	```bash
89	# 1. Both WASM targets are required (wasip1 for channels/tools, wasip2 for the daemon)
90	rustup target add wasm32-wasip1 wasm32-wasip2
91	
92	# 2. Install WASM build tools
93	cargo install wasm-tools cargo-component --locked
94	
95	# 3. Ensure rustup's rustc precedes Homebrew's in PATH.
96	#    Homebrew's rustc does NOT ship WASM targets — if it's found first, all
97	#    cargo component builds will fail with "can't find crate for `core`".
98	export PATH="$HOME/.rustup/toolchains/stable-$(rustc -vV | awk '/host/{print $2}')/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
99	which rustc   # must show ~/.rustup/toolchains/...
100	```
101	
102	Docker Desktop must be running (for PostgreSQL containers). If `docker pull` fails on first run, pull the image manually:
103	
104	```bash
105	docker pull pgvector/pgvector:pg16
106	```
107	
108	### macOS Quick Start
109	
110	```bash
111	cd ic
112	scripts/lunarwing-xmpp-test-env.sh mt-init
113	scripts/lunarwing-xmpp-test-env.sh build --with-wasm  # builds daemon, bridge, + all 20 WASM
114	scripts/lunarwing-xmpp-test-env.sh mt-up              # auto-detects macOS, renders + loads plists
115	scripts/lunarwing-xmpp-test-env.sh mt-verify
116	scripts/lunarwing-xmpp-test-env.sh mt-down
117	```
118	
119	`mt-up` automatically renders launchd plists and calls `launchctl load` — you do not need to run `mt-render-launchd` separately. Plists are tenant-scoped (`com.lunarwing.test.mt-a.*`, `com.lunarwing.test.mt-b.*`) so both tenants coexist in `~/Library/LaunchAgents/` without label conflicts. `mt-down` unloads all agents and removes them.
120	
121	### Single-tenant on macOS
122	
123	Single-tenant `up`/`down` uses direct PID management on all platforms — no launchd involvement needed. Docker (or colima) must be running for the PostgreSQL container.
124	
125	## Production Multi-Tenancy
126	
127	For production per-user multi-tenancy with OS-level isolation, see `docs/MULTITENANCY-PRODUCTION.md` and the admin script `ic/scripts/lunarwing-mt-admin.sh`. The production system provides dedicated OS users, registry-allocated port blocks, flock-serialized builds, and per-tenant PostgreSQL containers. It supports both systemd (user-level with linger) and OpenRC (system-level with supervise-daemon).
128	
129	The test harness documented here is for development/testing only. See the comparison table in `docs/MULTITENANCY-PRODUCTION.md` for the full list of differences.
130	
131	## Future Work
132	
133	- Weechat relay port integration (currently reserved, no harness plumbing yet)
134	- Per-instance worker container ports (nanocode4ironclaw, codex4ironclaw)
135	- Automatic port conflict detection in `doctor` command

1	# CLAUDE.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
4	
5	## What This Repo Is
6	
7	**LunarWing** is a hard fork of IronClaw (originally by NearAI), started February 2026. The core daemon lives in `ic/`. The product name is LunarWing; `ic/` and `ironclaw` are internal/binary names from upstream.
8	
9	This is a self-hosted, privacy-first AI agent. The fork prioritizes XMPP/OMEMO, Gotify, scheduled routines, systemd deployment, and open-protocol channels. Proprietary channels (Slack, Discord, Telegram) are intentionally unsupported. Upstream compatibility is not a goal.
10	
11	## Build & Test
12	
13	All Rust work happens inside `ic/`. Rust edition 2024, MSRV 1.92. Run from `ic/`:
14	
15	```bash
16	cargo fmt
17	cargo clippy --all --benches --tests --examples --all-features  # zero warnings required
18	cargo test                          # unit tests
19	cargo test --features integration   # + PostgreSQL tests
20	cargo test test_name -- --nocapture # single test

23	```

52	```

3	This document describes the production multi-tenant system managed by `ic/scripts/lunarwing-mt-admin.sh`. Each tenant is a real OS user with its own repo clone, build artifacts, services, PostgreSQL container, TensorZero proxy, and XMPP bridge.
4	
5	## Overview
6	
7	The admin script runs as root and handles:
8	
9	1. **OS user creation** with `loginctl enable-linger` (systemd) or system-level services with `User=` directives (OpenRC/Gentoo)
10	2. **Port allocation** from a centralized registry at `/etc/lunarwing/ports.json`
11	3. **Per-user repo clone** and sequential builds (flock-serialized to avoid OOM)
12	4. **Per-user PostgreSQL container** (Docker or Podman)
13	5. **Per-user TensorZero proxy** on its own port
14	6. **Per-user XMPP bridge** with its own JID
